claim: Opposite headings cancel whatever the speeds, and two lone birds are two strays: no group.
derivation: A (5, 5) v (1, 0) and B (15, 5) v (−2, 0). Headings (1, 0) and (−1, 0) cancel, so directionalAgreement = 0: it measures heading, not speed (E12).
Each bird's nearest neighbour is the other, 10 away: meanNeighbourDistance = 10 (E13).
10 ≥ 4.5, so the birds are not linked; each is a cluster of 1, fewer than 4 birds, so a stray, and clusterCount = 0 (E14).
Both birds are strays: strayShare = 1 (E18). No group, so it does not read as one group (O1).
